_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings. Two PreToolUse Bash hooks. (1) scripts/agent-pr-verify-gate.sh blocks `gh pr create` when the branch's diff vs origin/main touches any agent prompt / skill / reasoner-config file unless a verification receipt exists at `.claude/agent-test-receipts/<HEAD-sha>.txt`. Background: PRs #209/#211/#213 each claimed to fix #174/#212, all shipped untested via the actual code path, all left the bug live for ~24h. The receipt-keyed-by-HEAD design forces a fresh test on every rebase/amend. (2) scripts/cargo-target-guard.py blocks Cargo builds that choose their own target dir outside scripts/cargo-managed.sh, because those caches are never registered or pruned (#1754).
